findings.note: Both sentences open with یہ directly before a noun, so they first read as 'this source was saved before being recorded' and 'this publication was saved without a scope' (the masculine ہوا only repairs the second on a re-read). The fix names the subject with the namespace term ربط (ui.hub.links.source_unresolved 'اس ربط کی تنظیم'), masculine like the existing verbs. ur punctuation (، and ۔) and the namespace's 'عوامی Agent Hub' are unchanged and correct.
No bidi controls; the Latin 'Agent Hub' run sits inside RTL prose exactly as ui.hub.links.source_label_public does, and the ur guide leaves isolation to the render layer. No change.
